description:
Get Short Videos Search Results

Scrapes the Google Short Videos carousel (TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, etc.) for a query with location/uule, country (gl/cr), language (hl/lr), device type, and page-based pagination. Returns video title, thumbnail, duration, source platform, channel/creator, publish date, and direct video URL. Use for short-form content discovery, viral-trend monitoring, influencer research, cross-platform video aggregation, and sourcing short clips to summarize or embed in LLM responses.

cr.description: The country code for the country you want to limit the search to. Provide one exact documented value (237 allowed), e.g. `countryAF`, `countryAL`.

deviceType.description: Specify the device type for the search.

gl.description: The two-letter country code for the country you want to limit the search to. Provide one exact documented value (245 allowed), e.g. `ac`, `af`.

hl.description: The two-letter language code for the language you want to use for the search. Provide one exact documented value (159 allowed), e.g. `af`, `ak`.

location.description: Google canonical location for the search.

lr.description: The 'lr' parameter specifies the language of the websites to return results from. This parameter filters results based on the language of the web content.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, where 0 is the first page.

q.description: Search query term for retrieving short videos results.
